text_block_list.name: School Store Lady
text_block_list.text: Thanks for your business as always~

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Glad I didn't end up missing out on lunch. 
Following Pokke was definitely the right 
call.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
It was seriously packed today. If we 
waited through that line, lunch break 
would be over.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Well, a rice ball and cup noodles ain't 
bad once in a while.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Right about now... it's ready to eat...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
*SLUUUUUURP!* Aaah! So good! Miso really 
is the best!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Those instant noodles... aren't they the 
5-minute kind? I feel like you started 
eating way too early...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Huuuh...? Haha, don't sweat the small 
stuff!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Don't care if it's a bit early. I decide 
when it's time to eat."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Besides, if you space out and let 'em get 
soggy, they won't taste good, right?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"That's true...! Now I'm itching to try it 
out. I'm going to go buy some too...!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: One minute is way too fast...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
choice_data_list:

moment to eat.
